description: Monari, Filippo and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. CALIBRO is an existing R package designed to make Bayesian calibration of building-energy models easier to configure and use. The publication describes its techniques and procedures and demonstrates capability and reliability in two examples. This establishes an actual computational package, not only a conceptual calibration proposal. The inspected metadata do not supply a source-code repository, package-distribution endpoint or software licence, so source availability remains unknown. The paper deposit can be consulted for the documented package. The two examples do not establish performance for every building-model class or all uncertainty settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
